query: Nigel Farage Clacton 2024 general election vote share percentage and votes, turnout, and Reform UK national polling 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings:

**Clacton 2024 General Election (4 July 2024):**
- Nigel Farage (Reform UK) won with **21,225 votes / 46.2%** — a gain from the Conservatives
- **Majority: 8,405 votes (18.3% margin)** over Conservative Giles Watling (12,820 votes, 27.9%)
- **Turnout: 58.7%** (45,958 valid votes; electorate 78,245)

**Reform UK National Polling (2026):**
- Reform led the PollCheck 7-poll average at **24.7%** (24 July 2026), ahead of Labour (23.1%) and Conservatives (19.9%)
- Individual polls ranged: YouGov 25% (early May), Ipsos 27% with a 7-point lead (mid-May)
- Reform's lead narrowed through mid-2026 amid a row over Farage's finances ("Reform Fatigue"), with Survation showing Labour drawing level and Opinium (7 July) recording Reform's weakest result in 18+ months
- Notably, Reform polled only ~14% at the actual 2024 GE, so ~25% represents a substantial gain over its real-world performance

All figures are sourced to official Parliament records and named pollsters, with data vintages noted. No forecasts were made — only the documented result and current polling trajectory.
